verdict: Additive intake only, same dated lane, two same-day passes. First pass: two independently checked scTab deep-ensemble uncertainty ROC-AUC values (0.782 unknown/absent-type detection; 0.891 known-type error detection, kept as a separate endpoint), corrected after an independent review for averaging order, ensemble terminology and an unsupported training-setting claim. Second pass (same day): Abdelaal et al. 2019 Baron Human INTRA-dataset rejection-option evidence ingested (four median F1 values, three unlabeled percentages); scArches's ~84% accuracy figure re-checked and held unresolved (accuracy-formula denominator not stated for the reporting figure). The existing Table 1a known-type macro-F1 mapping is unchanged. No new literature search was performed in either pass; see the 2026-10-06 research dossier and retrieval-log.md for search provenance.
gaps: Both scTab protocols are donor-level holdouts within one pooled 249-dataset corpus, not a whole-study or whole-platform holdout; dataset/study overlap between splits is not directly confirmed.
Exact scTab Group 2/Group 3 denominators (cell/type counts) are not stated in the retrieved main text.
No rejection-at-coverage curve or demonstrated calibration for either scTab ROC-AUC value.

The Abdelaal protocol is INTRA-dataset only (same single dataset, stratified 5-fold CV); it does not establish cross-study or cross-platform transfer. The source's own genuine inter-dataset experiments (Fig. 4, Fig. 5) remain unretrieved as precise numeric values (graphical heatmap data only, Supp. Figs. S9/S10).
scArches's ~84% accuracy figure is not ingested: its accuracy-formula denominator (all-cell vs. accepted-only) is not stated for the figure that reports it.
Automated source review only; independent human scientific review remains outstanding.
Independent-study and coverage-aware unknown-type validation across methods remain gaps, consistent with the existing use-case evidence_gaps, which are not changed by this pass.

suggested_mappings.endpoint: Deep-ensemble uncertainty-score ROC-AUC distinguishing correctly predicted known cell types from cell types entirely absent from training, within one donor-held-out split of one pooled corpus.
suggested_mappings.rationale: Directly on the unknown-type-recognition endpoint, but single-corpus and donor-level only; no cross-study or cross-platform transfer established.
constraints: Donor-level holdout within one pooled 249-dataset corpus; not a whole-study or whole-platform holdout.
limitations: This is unknown/absent-type detection only; must not be combined with the separate known-type error-detection figure (0.891).
Exact Group 3 denominator not stated in the retrieved main text.
Reference labels are author annotations, not independent ground truth.
Automated source review only; independent human scientific review remains outstanding.

suggested_mappings.endpoint: Deep-ensemble uncertainty-score ROC-AUC distinguishing correctly from incorrectly predicted known cell types, within one donor-held-out split of one pooled corpus.
suggested_mappings.rationale: Measures known-type confidence/error detection (relevant to 'identify cells that require expert review'), not unknown-type detection; no cross-study or cross-platform transfer established.
constraints: Donor-level holdout within one pooled 249-dataset corpus; not a whole-study or whole-platform holdout.
limitations: This is known-type error detection, not unknown-type or absent-reference detection; must not be combined with the separate absent-type figure (0.782).
Exact Group 2 denominator not stated in the retrieved main text.
Reference labels are author annotations, not independent ground truth.
Automated source review only; independent human scientific review remains outstanding.

suggested_mappings.endpoint: Intra-dataset (stratified 5-fold cross-validation, Baron Human pancreatic dataset) median F1-score and, for rejection-capable classifiers, percentage of cells left unlabeled.
suggested_mappings.rationale: A conventional-classifier rejection-option baseline directly relevant to the use case's 'identify cells that require expert review' endpoint, but intra-dataset only; it does not establish cross-study or cross-platform transfer, and predates scTab/CellTypist/Azimuth/scANVI/scParadise.
constraints: INTRA-dataset (same single dataset, stratified 5-fold CV, identical folds across classifiers); NOT cross-study or cross-platform.
Baron Human only: 8,569 cells, 14/13 cell populations, inDrop protocol (Table 2).
limitations: Does not establish cross-study or cross-platform transfer; the source's own inter-dataset experiments (Fig. 4, Fig. 5) are not ingested here.
Median F1-score is a per-dataset summary statistic, not a per-population breakdown.
SVM's 0% implied unlabeled rate is not given its own result record.
Reference labels are the original Baron et al. study's author annotations, not independently adjudicated ground truth.
Automated source review only; independent human scientific review remains outstanding.
Percentage unlabeled is a coverage/rejection-rate tradeoff against the same classifier own median F1, not a standalone performance figure with a universal direction; read jointly, not in isolation.
8,569 cells is the Table 2 dataset-size figure, not independently confirmed as the exact scored denominator for any individual classifier result.
